name: Website Statistics
summary: Real-time visitor analytics for every website, read from the server's own access logs.
description: Page views, unique visitors, IPs, traffic, search-engine spiders, regions, pages, referrers, status codes, browsers and devices for each website, with hourly trends, comparison with the previous period and a live requests-per-second view. Works from the access logs the server already writes: no tracking script, no cookies, nothing added to your pages.
features: PV / UV / IP / traffic per site
